features: Adds Completed Events as a dedicated Admin Dashboard workflow separate from active scoring and long-term Archived Events
Completed events automatically disappear from the normal Scoring Dashboard saved-round list and from Select Existing Event
Published and Completed events cannot be reused to create a new scoring workflow, enforced both in the UI and server-side
Completed Events provides Open Scoring to reopen the exact existing scoring workflow for amendments without creating a duplicate event or round
Reopening a completed event unlocks the existing scoring workflow and returns the scorer to the existing scoring round for correction and resubmission
Completed Events remain separate from Archived Events; archiving is intended only when normal amendment access is no longer required
Admin Dashboard now shows a Completed Events navigation item and count
Archive Event list is restricted to completed events only
Published or completed scoring workflows cannot be destructively deleted from the normal Scoring Dashboard
Existing Bachata/Salsa discipline separation and one shared BDC ID architecture remain unchanged
